items.title: Management Raised the Bar For Eli Lilly Stock; Does The Chart Agree?
items.summary: Eli Lilly (LLY) raised its revenue forecast for 2026 on August 5, when it reported second-quarter results. Since the close before that release, Eli Lilly stock has gained 6.3%, while the S&P 500 fell 0.7%. The raise was modest and came with a lower earnings forecast, which is why the price chart is worth a look. So does Eli Lilly's price chart agree with management.

items.title: What Does Merck (MRK) Add To Its Oncology Pipeline With This KRAS Deal?
items.summary: Merck (NYSE:MRK) entered an exclusive global license agreement with SciBrunch Therapeutics to develop oral KRAS G12D inhibitor SPR2015. The deal gives Merck worldwide rights to SPR2015, an investigational small molecule targeting a mutation linked to several solid tumors. SciBrunch will collaborate with Merck on early development activities for SPR2015, which is designed as an oral targeted oncology therapy.
